title: Q2 Private Deployments: GTM Playbook & Rollout Sequencing
creator: Leah Chen
description: Goal: Define a tightly scoped Q2 go-to-market slice for Private/VPC/on-prem features that aligns engineering rollouts, sales enablement, and compliance sign-offs so we can convert 3 pilot enterprise accounts by end of Q2. Scope includes: (1) a hardened Private Control Plane GA checklist (RBAC, audit logging, KMS integration); (2) a packaging and upgrade playbook for on-prem installs; (3) a concise sales & solutions playbook, including pricing guardrails and SSO checklist; (4) observability SLAs and an onboarding dashboard template for early customers. This ticket coordinates PM-level sequencing, stakeholder approvals, and success metrics (pilot conversion, time-to-first-inference, and support cost per seat). Artifacts: Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRD/Private+Q2+GTM ; Design spec: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/drive-private-gtm ; Example GitHub checklist PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-ops/pull/142
